description: Legacy riding skill retained for old saves.  Riding now uses athletics.

level_descriptions_theory.description: You know that riders usually sit on top of the animal.
You understand basic mounting and rein control.
You understand balance, gait changes, and safe mounted movement.
You understand demanding maneuvers and mounted combat principles.
You understand advanced riding as well as a professional trainer.

level_descriptions_practice.description: You are likely to fumble a mount or lose your balance.
You can ride a calm, properly equipped animal.
You remain composed through ordinary turns and changes of pace.
You can control a mount reliably during combat.
You and your mount move as a practiced team.

name: Mounted Combat (legacy)
description: Legacy category retained for compatibility.  Mounted proficiencies are now in Athletics.
You can keep an effective fighting posture while controlling a living mount.
You compensate for a mount's movement while aiming and firing ranged weapons.
You align thrusting attacks with the motion and reach of your mount.
You deliver controlled cutting attacks without losing your seat.
You use the mount's momentum to deliver balanced blunt strikes.
